messages: Maya: Heads-up — noticed the in-product docs side panel uses the term 'model variant' in the UI, but our glossary/docs pages still use 'model version'. Users flagged this as confusing in support today. Jon: Yeah I've seen that too. Which terminology should we standardize on? Olivia: Product prefers 'model variant' for routing and rollout contexts. Docs historically used 'model version' when we first onboarded models. Sam: From a devex perspective, we should pick one canonical term and add crosslinks/aliases. Quick win: add an inline crosslink from the panel to the glossary entry. Maya: Also noticed a11y issues: when you open the docs panel with keyboard (pressing the ? or Help button) focus doesn't move into the panel — screen readers still reading the behind page. Priya: Good catch. We should move focus to the first heading inside the panel and add an aria-live polite status that says 'help panel opened'. I'll mock that in the next pass. Jon: Minor UX decision — do we open glossary links in the same tab or a new tab? For quick lookups same tab is fine, but deep docs should open in a new tab. What's the team preference? Olivia: Leaning to open glossary links in a new tab from the product panel (so users don't lose console state). Use `target=_blank` + `rel=noopener`. Sam: For implementation: we'll add a link like `Model variant (glossary)` and fire an analytics event `inproduct_docs_click` with `term:model_variant`. Easy to add. Maya: Docs action: add an alias in the glossary that references 'model variant' and include a short note 'previously referred to as model version' so older docs/search still resolve. Olivia: I'll add the alias and a redirect in the docs site. Also add a brief paragraph clarifying the difference between 'variant' (routing/weighting) and 'version' (model checkpoint) for clarity. Priya: Copy tweak suggestion for the panel: change the link label from 'Learn more' to 'Learn more about variants' (better for screen readers and clarity). Also add an explicit aria-label on the link: `aria-label="Open glossary: Model variant (opens in new tab)"`. Jon: Acceptance criteria request: can we get a short list of ACs so eng knows when to close? Maya: Proposed ACs: 1) Console uses canonical term 'model variant' in the panel UI; 2) Panel includes crosslink to glossary that opens in a new tab and has the aria-label above; 3) Keyboard focus moves into the panel on open and first heading is announced; 4) Clicks fire `inproduct_docs_click` with term metadata; 5) Docs site has alias/redirect from 'model version' to 'model variant' page; 6) Copy updated to 'Learn more about variants'. Sam: Noted. Implementation estimate: 2–3 dev points (panel focus + link + analytics). Docs PR + redirect separate. Priya: I'll upload a small 1-up mock in the thread in a bit — will show header focus outline and updated copy. Maya: Thanks — once PRs are up can someone drop the staging link here for a quick UX/copy/a11y pass? deploy-bot: docs-panel-fix branch deployed to staging at https://staging.redwood.ai/console — tests passing. (deployment note) Olivia: I'll review staging and check glossary redirect. Everyone: :thumbsup:
